_how_to: Owner-editorial FEATURED events. A slug listed here (and not yet expired) wins the lead card in its horizon window on /events — ahead of the draw/imagery/soonest heuristic. The heuristic stays the fallback, so an empty list changes nothing.
slug: the event's URL path after /events/ (open the event in the app and copy it from the address bar).
expires: the last Eastern day (YYYY-MM-DD) the feature holds; the day after, the entry retires itself. Usually the event's own date.
expires_at: optional exact ISO timestamp for an overnight event; use this instead of expires so the feature retires when the event ends, not at midnight or the end of the next day.
From a phone: github.com > this file > pencil icon > edit > commit to main. The deploy (~3 min) does the rest.
